## Who is the CEO of Cellebrite? [...] ## Who is the CEO of Cellebrite?

Thomas Hogan is the CEO of Cellebrite, leading an organization deeply committed to enabling customers around the world to protect and save lives, make communities safer, and accelerate justice — all while preserving important privacy and humanitarian rights. He brings 40+ years of technology experience, with over a decade of successful leadership roles as CEO of both public and private software companies.

Hogan has served on more than 10 public and private boards, held multiple advisory roles in both non-profit and for-profit organizations, and brings extensive international and M&A experience to his leadership of Cellebrite.

### Work History [...] ### Education History

Thomas Hogan earned a bachelor's degree in biomedical engineering from the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign. He went on to complete a master's in management with Distinction from Northwestern University's Kellogg School of Management, where he studied Finance and International Business. This strong academic foundation has supported his distinguished career leading technology companies at the highest levels.

## When did Thomas Hogan join Cellebrite?

Thomas Hogan assumed the role of CEO at Cellebrite in January 2025. Prior to stepping into the chief executive role, he served as Executive Chairman of the Board at Cellebrite beginning in August 2023, giving him deep familiarity with the company's strategy and operations before taking the helm.
